empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Create one from scratch, or import a SKILL.md from a URL.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: From a file or a URL. Imported skills are saved disabled until you vet them.

file.bodyHint: Parsed on the server like a URL import: frontmatter gives the name and description.
file.bodyPlaceholder:
---
name: my-rule
description: What it checks

file.tooLarge: The file is larger than 256 KB.
file.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from outside the workspace. Read it before enabling: once enabled, every agent that links it gets this text in its prompt.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
preview.title: Preview
preview.subtitle: What the reviewing agent receives: the body, delimited as its own block after a preamble that stops a skill from dropping findings.

list.agents: {count, plural, =0 {not linked} one {# agent} other {# agents}}

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.nameHint: Lowercase words joined by hyphens — the name the agent sees in its prompt.
config.bodyHint: The only text sent to the model. Everything else is metadata.
config.snapshotNote: A changed body is saved as v{version}.
config.deleteBody: Removes it from every agent that links it. This can't be undone.
config.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? It will be unlinked from every agent.

stats.runsHint: Review runs whose prompt included this skill, any version.
stats.emptyBody: Link this skill in an agent's Skills tab; runs that include it will show up here.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every body change is snapshotted, so you can see exactly what a past run was told.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version}? It is saved as a new version.
